decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 4 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity
Condition : 5 - The lighting levels for the proposed lettering and frame lighting shall not exceed 250 Candelas per square metre, as specified in the Planning Statement.
description: Installation of illuminated frame around main entrance doors, two back illuminated signs at the corner of the site and a timber seating area adjacent to main entrance.
